rationale: skill_installer performs the actual install action (unzip, validate, checksum, register a .skill bundle); skill-discovery is about finding/evaluating capabilities, not installing them. The 'install skill' trigger on skill-discovery was a broad intent catch that shadowed the true installer. Delegate: skill_installer keeps 'install skill' (the concrete action); skill-discovery retains discovery-oriented triggers (skill discovery, find a skill, discover skill, what skill can, skill for, how do I, can you help me with).
